newsitem.title: USA: PalEx buys two private companies with stock.
newsitem.headline: PalEx buys two private companies with stock.

text.p: PalEx Inc said it bought Sonoma Pacific Co and Sheffield Lumber and Pallet Co Inc, both privately held, for $29.3 million worth of its stock.
PalEx said the transaction was paid for with 2,455,400 shares of its common stock based on Thursday's closing price of $12 a share.

The company said in a statement that Sonoma, which makes new wood pallets and repairs and recycles used wood pallets, and Sheffield, which makes wood pallets and components, combined had revenues of roughly $23 million for the six months ended June 30.
